sn35.27:1.1: Sabbam bhikkhave anabhijānaṃ aparijānaṃ avirājayaṃ appajahaṃ abhabbo dukkhakkhayāya || || 3
sn35.27:1.2: Kiñca bhikkhave sabbam anabhijānam aparijānaṃ avirājayaṃ appajahaṃ abhabbo dukkhakkhayāya || || 4-6
sn35.27:1.3: Yaṃ ca kho cakkhu ye ca rūpā yañca cakkhuviññāṇam ye ca cakkhuviññāṇaviññātabbā dhammā || pe || || 7-8
sn35.27:1.4: Yā ca jivhā ye ca rasā yañca jivhāviññāṇaṃ ye ca jivhāviññāṇaviññātabbā dhammā || pe || || 9
sn35.27:1.5: Yo ca kāyo ye ca poṭṭhabbā yañca kāyaviññāṇaṃ ye ca kāyaviññāṇaviññātabbā dhammā || || 10
sn35.27:1.6: Yo ca mano ye ca dhammā yañca manoviññāṇam ye ca manoviññaṇaviññātabbā dhammā || || 11
sn35.27:1.7: Idaṃ kho bhikkhave sabbam anabhijānaṃ aparijānaṃ avirājayaṃ appajahaṃ abhabbo dukkhakkhayāya || || 12
sn35.27:2.1: Sabbam ca kho bhikkhave abhijānaṃ parijānam virājayaṃ pajahaṃ bhabbo dukkhakkhayāya || ||
sn35.27:2.2: Kiñca bhikkhave sabbam abhijānaṃ parijānaṃ virājayaṃ pajahaṃ bhabbo dukkhakkhayāya || || 13-15
sn35.27:2.3: Yañca bhikkhave cakkhum ye ca rūpā yañca cakkhuviññāṇam ye ca cakkhuviññāṇaviññātabbā dhammā || pe || || 16-17
sn35.27:2.4: Yā ca jivhā ye ca rasā yañca jivhāviññāṇaṃ ye ca jivhāviññāṇaviññātabbā dhammā ||
sn35.27:2.6: Yo ca mano ye ca dhammā yaṃ ca manoviññāṇaṃ ye ca manoviññāṇaviññātabbā dhammā || || 19
sn35.27:2.7: Idaṃ kho bhikkhave sabbam abhijānaṃ parijānaṃ virājayaṃ pajahaṃ bhabbo dukkhakkhayāyā
